meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne aur oily skin ke liye ₹700 ke andar kai behtareen serums available hain. Acne ke liye sabse acche ingredients **Salicylic Acid (BHA)** aur **Niacinamide** maane jaate hain, jo pores ko saaf karte hain aur acne marks ko kam karte hain.

Yahan kuch top-rated options hain jo ₹700 ke budget mein aate hain:

Minimalist ka yeh serum active acne, blackheads aur whiteheads ko target karne ke liye **potent 2% Salicylic Acid** aur soothing properties ke sath aata hai.

Yeh water-based exfoliant pores ko deep clean karta hai aur congestion ko kam karke skin texture ko improve karta hai.

Agar aapko active acne ke sath-sath oil control aur **acne spots / marks** hatane hain, toh yeh 10% Niacinamide serum ek behtareen choice hai.

Isme **Salicylic Acid aur Cica** ka blend hai jo acne ko theek karne ke sath-sath skin ki redness aur irritation ko bhi soothe karta hai.

Yeh serum Salicylic Acid ke sath **Zinc PCA aur Ceramides** provide karta hai jo extra oil ko control karke skin barrier ko healthy rakhte hain.
